name: skool
description: Unofficial Skool classroom tools (api2.skool.com + classroom page data). Session cookies are plugin variables — never committed.

SKOOL_AUTH_TOKEN.title: Skool auth_token cookie
SKOOL_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Portable paste: value of the auth_token cookie. Leave empty if using SKOOL_AUTH_MODE=chrome or SKOOL_COOKIE_FILE. Never commit this value.

SKOOL_CLIENT_ID.title: Skool client_id cookie
SKOOL_CLIENT_ID.description: Portable paste: value of the client_id cookie. Leave empty if using chrome mode or a cookie file. Never commit this value.

SKOOL_AWS_WAF_TOKEN.title: Skool aws-waf-token cookie
SKOOL_AWS_WAF_TOKEN.description: Portable paste: value of the aws-waf-token cookie (rotates often). Leave empty if using chrome mode or a cookie file. Never commit this value.

SKOOL_COMMUNITY_SLUG.title: Default community slug
SKOOL_COMMUNITY_SLUG.description: Optional default community slug used when a tool call omits community_slug.

SKOOL_AUTH_MODE.title: Auth mode
SKOOL_AUTH_MODE.description: Leave empty for portable env cookies. Set to chrome to read the local Chrome Cookies DB (same OS user; Linux v10 only).

SKOOL_USE_CHROME.title: Use Chrome cookies
SKOOL_USE_CHROME.description: Set 1 to enable same-machine Chrome fallback (same as SKOOL_AUTH_MODE=chrome).

SKOOL_COOKIE_FILE.title: Cookie file path
SKOOL_COOKIE_FILE.description: Optional Netscape cookies.txt or a file containing a Cookie: header. Used when the three env cookies are not all set. Never commit this file.

SKOOL_CHROME_PROFILE.title: Chrome profile directory
SKOOL_CHROME_PROFILE.description: Optional Chrome profile folder name (Default or Profile 1). Empty checks both well-known names only.

SKOOL_CHROME_COOKIES_DB.title: Chrome Cookies DB path
SKOOL_CHROME_COOKIES_DB.description: Optional exact path to a Chrome Cookies SQLite file. Not a filesystem search.
